moments.text: Green title card: "Unclassified", footage from mission report 8339574, 15 JAN 23 1251Z.
Infrared sensor view of empty grey sky, crosshair at centre. A dark aircraft silhouette sits left of centre, the second MQ-9 being filmed per the source.
A small dark elongated object enters at the left edge above the aircraft and crosses left to right just above the crosshair, leaving at the right edge.
A faint pale dotted streak trails behind the object as it passes the crosshair and crosses the right half.
The object is gone; only the aircraft silhouette remains on the left until the clip ends.
